description: Comprehensive psychological, augmetic, and biological traits for Covenant Broken characters.

trait_unaligned_observer.name: Unaligned Observer (The Fourth Path)
trait_unaligned_observer.effect: Grants cognitive agency resilience and questioning of dogmatic faction commands; resists neural subjugation.

trait_consensus_tether.name: Consensus Sub-Neural Tether
trait_consensus_tether.effect: Direct neural link to Iron Consensus hive network. Dampens emotional variance, increases calculation speed and tactical coordination at the cost of personal autonomy.

trait_purifier_fervor.name: Ashen Purifier Fervor
trait_purifier_fervor.effect: Fanatical devotion to pure baseline biology. High physical resilience against electromagnetic weaponry; strictly blocks installation of cybernetic augmetics.

trait_chimera_graft.name: Chimera Biomechanical Graft
trait_chimera_graft.effect: Warmachine actuators surgically fused into muscle and bone. High environmental hazard tolerance and devastating kinetic power, but steadily drives up neural strain and risk of silicon rot.

trait_severed_phantom.name: Severed Phantom Synapses
trait_severed_phantom.effect: Suffers from disconnected cognitive void after forcible severance from a collective warmachine link. Experiences profound empathy and survivor trauma, but possesses hyper-acute danger perception.

trait_genomic_custodian.name: Genomic Custodian
trait_genomic_custodian.effect: Uncompromising medical mastery dedicated to protecting unmutated human genome sequences from viral nanites and irradiated waste.
